name: RouteStation
source_reference: User feedback: the mark must read as a routing transfer station while remaining minimal
brief: Warm-white field. Two broad routes enter from the left, cross and exchange vertical order beneath one dominant near-black station gantry, then leave on the right. One amber route is active and one cobalt dot marks its input.

semantic_review.basis: original low-risk concept combining the strongest routing and station cues from the prior SVG exploration
semantic_review.notes: Limit the icon to two reordered routes and one architectural gantry so the transfer-station metaphor survives at 32px without visual clutter.

source_analysis.fidelity_target: preserve two reordered routes passing through one dominant station gantry
must_preserve: two routes enter and exit at different vertical positions
one amber active route travels from low-left to high-right
one large central gantry visibly covers the routing area
must_not_add: text, numbers, arrows, nodes, train, sleepers, circuit pins, shadow, gradient, glow, or platform frame

spec_constraints: central opening reveals the route exchange

acceptance_checks: reads as routes passing through a station rather than a standalone X
does not read as USB, share, microchip, or node graph
route ordering and station silhouette remain visible at 32px

claims: spec-driven reusable cross-platform icon source package
unrounded app/source canvas outputs retained separately from preview masking
